prompt: On the morning bus, Ravi drops his paper bag, and oranges roll down the aisle. He immediately (say) sorry loudly to the driver for the sudden mess. Then he turns to the two passengers who caught the fruit and (say) thank you for their quick help. Everyone laughs as Ravi (tell) them that they saved his breakfast.
explanation_ru: В устойчивых выражениях с извинениями и благодарностью используется глагол say (say sorry, say thank you), а при указании адресата речи без предлога to — глагол tell (tells them).

prompt: Before anyone clips into a climbing harness, Marta gathers the group near the wall. She (give) a focused ten-minute talk on checking figure-eight knots and calling out clear signals before lowering a partner. When a beginner asks a question, Marta (speak) calmly and demonstrates the safety check again. Finally, she (tell) everyone to double-check their partner's buckle.
explanation_ru: Выражение give a talk означает «выступить с краткой речью/инструктажем», speak calmly описывает манеру речи, а tell + дополнение + инфинитив выражает инструкцию или просьбу.

prompt: During the final set, Hana accidentally serves before her opponent finishes tying his shoelace. She walks up to the net at once to (say) sorry for rushing the serve. Her opponent smiles and (say) that they can replay the deciding point fairly. Hana (say) thank you for his sportsmanship before walking back to the baseline.
explanation_ru: Глагол say используется в устойчивых фразах say sorry и say thank you, а также для введения придаточного предложения с союзом that (says that...).

prompt: Under the projected stars of the planetarium dome, Salma steps up to the microphone. She (give) a clear fifteen-minute talk explaining why the Moon looks slightly larger near the horizon than high overhead. Throughout the session, she (speak) clearly so every visitor in the back row can follow the optical illusion. Afterwards, several children stay to (talk) to her about telescopes.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое сочетание give a talk обозначает выступление или лекцию; speak clearly характеризует чёткость речи, а talk to someone about something используется для живого обсуждения темы.

prompt:
Dear Dr. Vance,
I am writing to (say) thank you for lending me a spare microscope lamp yesterday morning. When my suitcase was delayed at the airport, I worried I would miss my lab slot, so I really appreciate your help. Please (tell) me whenever you need the lamp returned, and I will bring it straight to your office.
explanation_ru: В выражении say thank you всегда ставится глагол say, а в конструкции с прямым дополнением лица (tell me) используется глагол tell.

prompt: Every Saturday morning, Tariq hosts a digital literacy workshop at the community centre. Today he (give) a calm talk on spotting fake delivery text messages and organizing family photos into labelled folders. He always (speak) slowly when introducing new settings on a smartphone. At the end, participants (talk) about the scams they have seen recently.
explanation_ru: Для проведения лекции или выступления используется give a talk, скорость и манера речи передаются через speak slowly, а обмен мнениями по теме — через talk about.

prompt: Hi everyone! I just wanted to (say) sorry for accidentally posting a silly cat video here instead of our monthly book club reading list. My phone slipped while I was uploading the file. I also want to (say) thank you to Sam for deleting it so quickly, and I can (tell) you that the real list is attached now!
explanation_ru: В устойчивых формулах извинения и благодарности используется say (say sorry, say thank you), а когда указан адресат сообщения (you), ставится tell (tell you that...).

prompt: Hi! I am messaging to (say) thank you for helping me out during that sudden downpour twenty minutes ago. You handed me a dry towel and a spare paper bag for my wet bicycle saddle without me even asking. I have already (tell) my friends about how kind your café is!
explanation_ru: Благодарность выражается устойчивой фразой say thank you, а рассказ кому-либо о чём-либо требует глагола tell с прямым дополнением (told my friends about).

prompt: Before the annual school sports day begins, the head teacher steps onto the grass with a megaphone. She (give) a brief, energetic speech reminding everyone to cheer loudly for the last runner, not just the winner. She (tell) the students that team spirit matters more than medals. Then she (say) good luck to all four houses.
explanation_ru: Выражение give a speech означает «произнести речь»; после tell сразу следует адресат (the students), а пожелание удачи оформляется глаголом say (say good luck).

prompt: After the bell rings, Mei stays behind for a minute by the window. She wants to (say) sorry for accidentally knocking over the class watering can near the desks. Her teacher smiles and (say) that accidents happen to everyone. Mei also (say) thank you for helping her dry her soaked notebook pages with paper towels.
explanation_ru: Глагол say используется в устойчивых оборотах say sorry и say thank you, а также для передачи слов без указания слушателя (says that...).

prompt:
Paloma: I want to explain my essay outline, so let's (speak) Japanese for a moment, though I keep forgetting linking words.
Haruto: No problem, we can (talk) about the main sections in slow English instead.
Paloma: Thanks! Let me (tell) you my three main arguments while you sketch the timeline.
explanation_ru: С названиями языков употребляется глагол speak (speak Japanese), обсуждение темы вводится через talk about, а передача информации собеседнику — через tell you.

prompt: Halfway through his ten-minute lecture on coastal tides, Ewan pauses near the stage edge. While he is (give) his talk, he notices that his laser pointer is shining on his own shoe instead of the screen. He laughs, (say) sorry to the audience for the tiny red dot on his sneaker, and points back at the tide chart.
explanation_ru: В значении «читать лекцию / выступать» используется устойчивое выражение give a talk (в форме Continuous: is giving), а извинение выражается фразой say sorry.

prompt:
Ines: Let's (talk) about the open-book exam rules because I am sure handwritten index cards are allowed.
Bruno: Look at page two of the syllabus—it clearly (say) that only printed formula sheets are permitted.
Ines: Oh! Actually, it also (tell) us that no notes at all are allowed in part one, so we were both wrong!
explanation_ru: Для обсуждения вопроса используется talk about; когда речь идёт о тексте документа без указания адресата, ставится say (it says that...), а при наличии дополнения (us) — tell (tells us that...).

prompt: Hi Dev, I just wanted to ___ thank you for lending me your spare scientific calculator five minutes before the statistics exam started.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении благодарности используется только глагол say: say thank you.

prompt: Cedric arrives early for a sample check and cannot ___ English well enough to name the brass hinges, so Amina draws a quick sketch and smiles.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения владения иностранным языком и общения на нём используется глагол speak (speak English).

prompt: Camille ___ a crisp fifteen-minute talk on lifting heavy archive boxes safely, using an empty crate that unexpectedly hides an office cat.
explanation_ru: С существительным talk в значении «выступление, краткий инструктаж» используется глагол give (give a talk).

prompt: Otto and Greta talked about the missing green folders until Greta told to Otto that the box was under the wobbly printer table.
answer: Otto and Greta talked about the missing green folders until Greta told Otto that the box was under the wobbly printer table.
accepted_answers: Otto and Greta talked about the missing green folders until Greta told Otto that the box was under the wobbly printer table.
Otto and Greta talked about the missing green folders until Greta said to Otto that the box was under the wobbly printer table.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу ставится прямое дополнение без предлога to (told Otto, а не told to Otto).

prompt: Lorenzo wrote to say sorry for sending the wrong chapter draft yesterday and to say thank you to Chiara for spotting the mistake.
answer: Lorenzo wrote to say sorry for sending the wrong chapter draft yesterday and to say thank you to Chiara for spotting the mistake.
accepted_answers: Lorenzo wrote to say sorry for sending the wrong chapter draft yesterday and to say thank you to Chiara for spotting the mistake.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: устойчивые выражения say sorry и say thank you употреблены грамматически верно.

prompt: During the job interview, Veda spoke Hindi and clear English smoothly to show how she would help international visitors.
answer: During the job interview, Veda spoke Hindi and clear English smoothly to show how she would help international visitors.
accepted_answers: During the job interview, Veda spoke Hindi and clear English smoothly to show how she would help international visitors.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: для указания языков, на которых говорит человек, используется глагол speak без предлога (spoke Hindi and clear English).
